As Time Warner (TWX) Share Price Declined, Shareholder Graham Capital Management LP Lowered by $2.35 Million Its Position; Heronetta Management LP Increased Its Enbridge (ENB) Stake by $600,000
June 15, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Heronetta Management Lp increased its stake in Enbridge Inc (ENB) by 13.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Heronetta Management Lp bought 15,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.90% with the market. The institutional investor held 124,500 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.05 million, up from 109,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Heronetta Management Lp who had been investing in Enbridge Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $54.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.50% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $32.11. About 1.96 million shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 20.51% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.08% the S&P500. Kenneth Tropin decreased its stake in Time Warner Inc (TWX) by 3.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Graham Capital Management Lp sold 25,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.16% with the market. The hedge fund run by Kenneth Tropin held 616,166 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $58.28M, down from 641,166 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Graham Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $77.27B market cap company. It closed at $98.77 lastly. It is down 5.23% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.80% the S&P500. Graham Capital Management Lp, which manages about $16.17 billion and $1.87B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 70,900 shares to 76,676 shares, valued at $12.87 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Herbalife Ltd by 10.00M shares in the quarter, for a total of 35.00M shares, and has risen its stake in Valeant Pharmaceuticals Intl (Put) (NYSE:VRX).

After $2.28 actual EPS reported by Time Warner Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.70% negative EPS growth.
